# Moksha Sewa

Moksha Sewa helps families in India request dignified cremation assistance, ambulance or hearse van support, pandit guidance, ritual samagri, prayer hall coordination, volunteer care, and donation-backed sewa.

## Key Pages

- Home: https://mokshasewa.org/
- About Moksha Sewa: https://mokshasewa.org/about
- Request Cremation Assistance: https://mokshasewa.org/request-help
- Volunteer Registration: https://mokshasewa.org/volunteer/register
- Contact Support: https://mokshasewa.org/contact
- Blog and Ritual Guides: https://mokshasewa.org/blog
- Photo Gallery: https://mokshasewa.org/mokshagallery
- Video Gallery: https://mokshasewa.org/mokshavediogallery
- Donation Support: https://mokshasewa.org/donation

## Main Actions

- Families can submit help requests at `/request-help`.
- Volunteers can register at `/volunteer/register`.
- Donors can support funeral and cremation assistance at `/donation`.
- Visitors can contact the team by phone, email, WhatsApp, or the contact form at `/contact`.
